audio.text: The professor's office hours keep changing.

options: I changed my office last month.
She posts the updated times on the course page.
Her office is on the third floor.

why.en: Complaint → helpful information. A reuses "changed" and "office".
why.tr: Şikâyet → yardımcı bilgi. A "changed" ve "office" kelimelerini tekrar ediyor.
why.es: Queja → información útil. A reutiliza "changed" y "office".
